services.name: Admission
services.desc: Mike Love isn’t just painting pretty pictures-he’s preserving a crucial piece of Florida art history. As the nephew of Al Black, one of the original Florida Highwaymen, Love carries forward a tradition that revolutionized how Black artists sold their work in the Jim Crow South. Mike is hosting a landscape painting workshop at Studio ArtFarm on Friday August 14! Learn techniques inspired by the legendary Florida Highwaymen while creating your own vibrant landscape painting in this unique hands-on experience. Reserve your spot now at
